description: First release: Unison bridge for Deezer 9.0.26.3 (add the playing track to a Deezer playlist from Unison).

patches.name: Unison bridge
patches.description: Lets the Unison app add the playing track to one of your Deezer playlists, using the session you are already signed in with.

release_notes: First release. **Unison bridge** for Deezer 9.0.26.3: lets Unison 1.2.0+ add the playing track to one of your Deezer playlists. See the README for install steps and caveats (the official Deezer must be uninstalled first).
